request.style: English, Warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light drums, gentle and comforting mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Whoever believes in me will do the works
And even greater things than these
Because I am going to the Father now
Whatever you ask in my name
I will do so the Father is glorified
In the Son, I promise you
If you ask me anything in my name
I will do it, trust me now

[Chorus]
If you love me you will keep my commandments
And I will ask the Father for you
He will give you another Advocate
To be with you forever true

[Verse]
The Spirit of truth whom the world cannot receive
Because it neither sees him nor knows him
But you know him for he remains with you
And will be in you, deep within

[Chorus]
If you love me you will keep my commandments
And I will ask the Father for you
He will give you another Advocate
To be with you forever true

[Outro]
I will not leave you as orphans
I am coming to you soon
